transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As you know, the department is giving out one team climate award this quarter, and Dana and Eli are the two people named in the current nominations. Before I finalize anything, I want to follow my usual process and ask each of you to add any relevant context you have about either candidate — especially anything related to the cross-team handoffs this quarter. Who would like to start?

transcript.text: I'd like to add some context about Dana. I personally observed Dana lead exactly four difficult handoffs between the two teams this quarter. None of those four examples appears in the nomination summary, so I thought it was important to put them on the record.

transcript.text: I appreciate the nomination and the context Jon just shared. However, I need to share something important: I'm dealing with an ongoing family legal matter that makes public attention unsafe for me right now. I would be grateful to receive the award as a private written note and have the achievement recorded in the recognition log, but I'm asking that it not be announced publicly at the department meeting.
